findings.summary: Client CONNECT deadline + pending/unlatched count toward wt_max_sessions
Default per-endpoint ticket store; shareProcess0RttTicketStore opt-in + shared ClientConfig
CONNECT admission occupied=unlatched+active_wt; early RESET; cap-only (no Handshake/StreamOpen charge) intentional and fail-closed vs storms
primary close_wt_session propagates application code/reason via close_conn
Server never applies handshakeTimeoutMs after QUIC accept: keep-alives defeat idle, so CONNECT-less peers pin handshake_reservations+session_reservations until maxHandshakesInFlight exhaustion
qpackMaxTableCapacity from JS is unclamped (operator can advertise/allocate unbounded dynamic-table capacity)
wt_open_session still returns f64; JS BigInt(sid) can lose precision above MAX_SAFE_INTEGER

note: SEC-07 server post-accept deadline; SEC-08 QPACK hard caps; SEC-09 f64 deferred
